page_title: FUL 3-0 TOT | Fulham v Tottenham Hotspur 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Hamstring Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+6' Harrison Reed (Fulham) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+4' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
90+2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) inside the box.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Guglielmo Vicario was forced into action to thwart Harry Wilson (Fulham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) coming on for Heung-Min Son.
87' Dejan Kulusevski provides the assist in the box, but Richarlison (Tottenham) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
85' Harrison Reed (Fulham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
83' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Richarlison (Tottenham) heads on.
82' That's the end of the game for Timothy Castagne, who is replaced by Kenny Tete (Fulham).
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) for Alex Iwobi.
81' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Sasa Lukic is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
80' A substitution has been made. Brennan Johnson goes off and Richarlison (Tottenham) comes on.
79' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
79' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
76' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:3.
72' Here is a change. Andreas Pereira is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Harry Wilson (Fulham).
70' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

70' Timo Werner (Tottenham) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the left side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Bernd Leno. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

69' Brennan Johnson sprays a pass out to Timo Werner (Tottenham), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
67' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' Tottenham are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pape Matar Sarr trots off the pitch and is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
66' Substitution. Yves Bissouma makes way for Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
66' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) replaces James Maddison.
66' Celebrations are cut short for Fulham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
65' The Fulham players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
64' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) gets to the rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast the ball into to the bottom left corner.
64' Here comes a substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Rodrigo Muniz.
63' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
61' 3 - 0 Goal! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 3:0.
61' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner.

60' What a sweet touch by Timothy Castagne (Fulham) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Guglielmo Vicario to hold. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.
55' Yellow card. Joao Palhinha (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
55' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) jumps into a tackle and Robert Jones signals a foul.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Looks like Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Timothy Castagne puts a cross into the box and finds Sasa Lukic (Fulham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
48' Brennan Johnson crosses and Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
46' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

46' Willian (Fulham) whips the ball into the box and Alex Iwobi takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Tottenham win a corner.
45+1' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' No offside! Referee Robert Jones points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Fulham players.
44' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Fulham players aren’t happy.

42' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Antonee Robinson. The score is now 1:0.
41' James Maddison (Tottenham) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
41' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
40' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
39' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' It could have been a good chance to score! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fails to release Brennan Johnson with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
36' Ball possession – 43:57.
34' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

32' Destiny Udogie has a look up and finds James Maddison (Tottenham) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
29' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dejan Kulusevski. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
28' James Maddison (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
28' Heung-Min Son loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham). It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
27' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Bernd Leno anticipates well and smothers the ball.
25' The keeper makes a simple save after Willian (Fulham) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

25' That's unlucky! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

24' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Rodrigo Muniz is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
23' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
21' Some patient build-up play from Fulham as they look to unlock the defence.
18' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Jones blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Tottenham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Tottenham.
14' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) swings it in and Rodrigo Muniz gets on the end of it, but Guglielmo Vicario shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
13' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
12' The Fulham players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.

11' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
11' Neat link-up play between Alex Iwobi (Fulham) and Rodrigo Muniz, but Guglielmo Vicario reads the game well and the move breaks down.
10' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals. Tottenham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.

8' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
7' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) picks out Rodrigo Muniz with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
6' Willian (Fulham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

5' Alex Iwobi plays a short pass through to Andreas Pereira (Fulham) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

4' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Robert Jones blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Fulham get a corner.
2' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
1' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
